_comment: ρ=0 (scan-to-scan independent) variant of scenario_missed_detections_swerling.json (target realism report, Part I §4.2). IDENTICAL to that file -- same swerling1 model, amplitude 0.0006, seed 99999 -- except frame_corr is 0.0 instead of 0.9. Same mean SNR and same fade marginal (so the same long-run miss rate); only the burst structure differs. Exists for the single-run CLI illustration of SCATTERED (uncorrelated) misses, to contrast with the ρ=0.9 bursty timeline (tracker_stress_missed_detections_swerling.png). The statistical claim remains the §4.2 sweep.
